RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
This lease is between the Landlord and Tenant for the apartment at 12 Beacon Street, Boston, MA.
1. Term and Renewal: This lease runs for one year. The Tenant must give the Landlord at least 60 days written notice before the end of the term to renew.
2. Rent: Monthly rent is $1,800, due on the first of each month.
3. Repairs: The Landlord must repair heating, plumbing, and electrical problems within 48 hours of written notice.
4. Security Deposit: The Landlord holds a $1,800 security deposit and will return it within 60 days after move-out, minus any itemized deductions.
5. Late Fee: A late fee of $50 applies if rent is paid after the 5th of the month.
